description.html: This water dish styled as red stone has a squarish shape with irregular, broken edges, like a piece of rock. The red-orange color with whitish streaks resembles the sandstone and rocks of semi-desert landscapes.

That is why it fits best in a desert terrarium with red sand or a clay substrate, where a grey or green dish would look out of place. It is an excellent choice for a bearded dragon or leopard gecko setup when you want everything to look like one natural landscape.
The squarish shape is also practical: the dish sits snugly against the glass or in a corner, so it does not take up space in the middle of the terrarium, where your animal usually runs and hunts.

Place the dish on the cooler side of the terrarium and level it in the substrate so it sits firmly. Change the water every day. In a desert terrarium the dish should not be too large, so that humidity does not rise too much. Read more about setups on our terrariums page.
